name: Harvey
summary: AI platform for law firms and corporate legal teams covering research, drafting and review.
description: Harvey provides AI tailored to legal work for law firms, corporate legal teams and professional services firms. It supports contract analysis, due diligence, compliance, litigation, research and drafting through a platform with agents and workflows. The company announced raising $550M at a $15.5B valuation. No public prices are listed. Use cases are organised by practice area and customer type. The platform is available to firms worldwide.

howToUse.title: Open Harvey
howToUse.description: Open Harvey and choose Request a demo. No public prices are listed, and the platform is offered to firms worldwide.

howToUse.title: Choose a practice and a customer type
howToUse.description: Pick a path for your customer type, such as in-house, law firm, or mid-size firm, and a practice area such as litigation or transactional work. Harvey is built for law firms, corporate legal teams, and professional services firms.

howToUse.title: Run the legal work
howToUse.description: Use agents and workflows for contract analysis, due diligence, compliance, litigation, research, and drafting. On the platform, Contract Intelligence handles reviews, Vault stores and bulk-analyzes documents, and Knowledge covers legal research.

howToUse.title: Assign the work and review it
howToUse.description: Use Intake to capture and route a legal request, then Legal Work Orchestration to assign, execute, and review that work with agents and your team.
